blockers.finding: All eight registered benefit gates fail. Every adjusted interval includes both 0 and +0.02. This does not establish harm, zero effect, equivalence, or a six-family success claim.
blockers.next_criterion: For any future mechanism benefit claim, register its contrasts/splits and simultaneous interval allocation before fitting; generate a new independent confirmation only after source/model publication; require the relevant registered lower confidence bound to exceed the declared practical margin. Retain every registered fit.

blockers.finding: Three development fits requested 47/72/76/328 fits under a normal approximation and a heuristic 1.25 SD multiplier; the resource cap of 16 fits was binding. Neither 80% power nor a variance confidence bound is established.
blockers.next_criterion: Choose a feasible next confirmation size from independently fitted development differences under a frozen planning rule, including its uncertainty and finite-sample interval method. If the resource cap again binds, explicitly retain the shortfall instead of claiming planned power.

blockers.finding: No complete-cost superiority gate was registered or passed. The 38 registered workers consumed 12,578.571290 CPU seconds; analysis, transport, native and auxiliary probes have additional separate receipts. Nested candidate and subprocess costs cannot be added again. Bayes/fixed includes unused oracle-Q computation and is an unoptimized reference.
blockers.next_criterion: Predeclare the task-quality requirement, end-to-end cost scope, deployment/reuse count and uncertainty rule. Measure optimized baselines under that scope, including setup, training/collection, discarded development, inference and I/O. A saving claim requires the registered quality criterion and lower complete amortized cost at the registered reuse count; report the break-even count or its absence. Energy requires a separate measured endpoint.

blockers.finding: The four arms assigned a nominal 16 CPU second budget have unequal actual learning-plus-collection CPU. FPT sustained reaches 24.671916 seconds and FPT impulse 29.936920 seconds. This panel cannot be described as strictly matched actual CPU.
blockers.next_criterion: Use bounded or interruptible collection and optimization. Before running the next comparison, register a numerical CPU-overrun and between-arm disparity tolerance; require every included fit/arm to meet that tolerance with collection charged inside the same budget. Retain actual updates, overruns and all failures.

blockers.finding: Allocated structured cell models have 1,707 parameters, but ordinary has 1,640 structurally active coordinates versus 1,707 for event models. The structured head removes 99 parameters. Raw-history/accumulator and sampled-cell models preserve observations differently; all retain public causal inputs. Analytic_increment therefore does not isolate a pure analytic operator.
blockers.next_criterion: Define the next matching criterion explicitly and verify allocated/reachable parameters, active dynamics, observation/time interfaces and retained-history capacity for each arm. Add controls for unmatched factors before attributing a utility difference uniquely to an analytic operator or claiming effective-capacity equivalence.

blockers.finding: One halfway greedy snapshot can become stale. Coarse unseen-stratum and selected-Q error improvements are descriptive and do not establish coverage of the final greedy state/action distribution. Training uses detached realized state indices; fixed-behavior prefix mass is not an autonomous policy gradient.
blockers.next_criterion: Predeclare a final-policy coverage representation, selected-action Q-error/margin and utility criteria; collect feedback trajectories or held-out final-policy states and audit the full declared support. If optimizing expected policy return instead, include action probabilities in the task-by-cell joint path weights and validate the declared policy gradient.

blockers.finding: Impulse changes both ongoing drift and future driver features. The accumulator lacks structured_off, so its free_off-to-structured_on contrast mixes head and occupancy. Cell-only information is distinct from the full head/owner information; actual event/recovery readout differences remain selected and confounded.
blockers.next_criterion: Separate drift versus bank-driver factors, event sign and reset on matched observation/cost interfaces; add the missing factorial controls. Compare before/after information on the same selected population and evaluate a separately trained held-out decoder before treating current readout MSE as irrecoverable memory loss or causal utility.

blockers.finding: The calibrated/reset-aware and native renewal checks concern a separate finite continuous-time CTMC. Main task efficacy still uses the inherited 17-state interval law with at most one new event per interval. Native fitted-parameter consistency is not task-policy transfer.
blockers.next_criterion: Declare one transition law and future-input assumption across training, prediction and native execution; integrate that law explicitly, verify event and remaining-time behavior/checkpoint restoration, then run a newly frozen efficacy confirmation. Parameter transfer alone does not satisfy this criterion.

blockers.finding: Exact finite-CTMC sampling and checkpoint consistency do not establish a continuous-voltage Brownian first-passage or multi-renewal limit.
blockers.next_criterion: Specify the diffusion and boundary/reset/refractory limit, establish a consistent approximation, and measure first-hit-time, post-event evolution and renewal distribution error against independent references under refinement. Increasing grid size alone is insufficient.

blockers.finding: Production ACK-owner integration, crash-atomic checkpoint commits and cross-architecture determinism are outside the completed standalone native checks.
blockers.next_criterion: Define the production owner/checkpoint contract, including event times, pending events, RNG and recovery state; validate crash/restart and acknowledgement idempotence under fault injection and specify supported determinism scope before any production activation.

blockers.finding: This confirmation belongs to the present frozen version. It and the historical confirmation remain retained evidence; neither may be relabeled as a fresh independent confirmation after tuning.
blockers.next_criterion: Complete all future development/validation choices, publish source, all models and primary design, then generate a separately registered confirmation with independent fit/data seeds. Keep source/model/receipt hashes and generation chronology, with all attempted fits and costs retained.

current_confirmation_role: Retained confirmation evidence for the exact frozen version; may inform a future explicitly identified development stage but is not a new independent tuning/confirmation set.
scope: Claim and next-experiment decision ledger; no protocol, threshold, model, dataset or experiment changed by this file.
